title: Audi Trainee Sales Executive
description:
About the role

A fantastic opportunity is available for a Trainee Sales Executive to join our team at Reading Audi.

As a Sytner Trainee Sales Executive, you will be the first point of contact for customers by initiating conversation and building rapport to excite them about the brand. You will promote the benefits and unique selling points of Audi, accessories and vehicle ownership.

This is a full-time role which can typically include weekends to ensure we provide our customers with the highest possible levels of service.

About you

Ideally, you will have previous experience of working in retail and be able to maintain exceptional customer care in a competitive environment.

A passion for delivering excellent customer service is a key attribute of the position, along with a determination to expand your knowledge and inspire others; you will demonstrate enthusiasm and self-motivation to excel in customer service. We offer extensive training to allow you to develop expert knowledge of the Audi.

This role is a fantastic opportunity for those who enjoy meeting people and working for a prestige brand in a highly successful and motivated team.

A full and valid UK driving license would be beneficial / preferred.

When applying for this role please consider that we require candidates to have obtained GCSE grade A -C/9-4 or Functional Skills Level 2 (or equivalent) in the following subjects, English, Maths and 1 other subject as a threshold level of qualification.

Why Sytner?

Sytner Group are delighted to provide an industry-leading benefits package.

We are passionate about continuous improvement and building an environment where everyone feels valued, appreciated and able to reach their full potential.
- Enhanced Holiday Entitlement 33 days inc. bank holidays
- Industry-leading Maternity, Paternity and Adoption Pay
- Career Development
- Recognition of Long Service every 5 years
- Discounted Car Schemes
- High Street Discounts
- Discounted Gym memberships
- Cycle to work scheme
- One day a year paid voluntary / community work

At Sytner, our values and the way we behave are important to us. We are committed to creating an equitable working environment where we value and respect every individual's unique contribution, supporting our colleagues to thrive and achieve their full potential.

As part of our commitment to Diversity and Inclusion, you have the right to ask for changes / adjustments to job interviews and the recruitment process. For more information around reasonable adjustments and the recruitment process please click here.

Unsure? Read on

We represent over 23 of the world's most prestige vehicle brands, across our 140 UK dealerships.

We pride ourselves on Developing Talent and Building Careers and our colleagues recently scored Sytner Group an outstanding 89% on our colleague engagement survey.

title: Business Development Executive
description:

- Document, track and monitor all leads and activities in the CRM

- Nurture relationships with longer term prospects

The successful Business Development Representative will have the following related skills / experience:
- Highly motivated and a self-starter
- Strong desire to meet and exceed quota on a monthly basis
- Comfortable with prospecting and cold calling to a global market
- Excellent telephone manner with confident negotiation skills
- Previous sales experience would be advantageous

title: Freight Internal Sales Executive
description:
Internal Sales Executive - Freight Forwarding

Location: Crowthorne, Berkshire
Salary: Up to 35,000
Hours: Monday - Friday, 09:00 - 17:30
Job Type: Full-time, Permanent

An established international freight forwarding business is looking to recruit an Internal Sales Executive to join its team in Crowthorne.

This is a great opportunity for someone with previous freight forwarding sales experience who enjoys pricing, customer interaction and securing new business opportunities across Air, Sea and Road Freight.

The Role

Working closely with customers, overseas partners, carriers and the operations team, you will be responsible for producing competitive freight quotations and following opportunities through from initial enquiry to shipment handover.

Key responsibilities will include:
- Preparing competitive and accurate pricing for bids, tenders and general quotations across Air, Sea and Road Freight
- Generating quotations through CargoWise
- Liaising with airlines and shipping lines to obtain competitive rates
- Following up quotations and developing opportunities with customers
- Liaising with UK customers and overseas partners/agents
- Handling customer and pricing-related queries
- Passing successfully secured shipments across to the operations team with clear instructions Internal sales role JD (2)

The Candidate

You will ideally have:
- A minimum of 2 years sales experience within freight forwarding
- A good understanding of the freight forwarding industry
- Strong customer service and negotiation skills
- Excellent verbal, written and telephone communication
- The ability to provide accurate quotations across Air, Sea and Road Freight
- Good numerical ability and attention to detail
- Experience using Microsoft Word, Excel and Outlook
- The ability to work effectively in a busy, competitive environment
- A professional, positive attitude and willingness to learn and develop

WR Logistics are a leading recruitment partner for the logistics and supply chain industry, recruiting across the UK, Europe, and the USA for permanent opportunities.

WR Logistics is acting as an Employment Agency in relation to this vacancy

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
Sales Development Representative

The Role

We are looking for a driven and commercially minded Sales Development Representative (SDR) to join a growing financial services business specialising in solutions for the UK recruitment sector.

This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys speaking to businesses, building relationships and generating new opportunities, with a clear route to developing a long-term career within business development and sales.

You will be responsible for identifying prospective recruitment businesses, engaging with decision-makers, understanding their requirements and qualifying opportunities before handing them across to the wider commercial team.

Key Responsibilities
- Identify and research prospective recruitment agencies and businesses.
- Proactively contact potential clients through phone, email and LinkedIn.
- Speak with business owners, directors and senior decision-makers.
- Introduce the company's finance and business solutions and understand their requirements.
- Qualify inbound and outbound opportunities against agreed criteria.
- Build relationships with prospects and create genuine interest in the proposition.
- Book qualified meetings and opportunities for the Business Development team.
- Maintain accurate prospect and pipeline information within the CRM.
- Follow up consistently with prospective clients to develop opportunities.
- Work closely with the wider sales and account management teams to maximise conversion.
- Develop a strong understanding of the recruitment finance / invoice finance market and the challenges recruitment businesses face.
- Contribute to outbound campaigns and initiatives designed to generate new business.
- Consistently work towards agreed activity, meeting and opportunity targets.

The Ideal Candidate

We're looking for someone who is confident, personable and commercially driven, with the resilience and enthusiasm to pick up the phone and speak to new businesses.

Ideally, you will have:
- Previous experience in SDR, BDE, telesales, recruitment, business development or a similar outbound sales role.
- Strong telephone and communication skills.
- The confidence to speak with business owners and senior decision-makers.
- A genuine interest in sales and relationship building.
- A proactive and persistent approach to generating new opportunities.
- Strong organisation and CRM/pipeline management skills.
- The ability to ask good questions and understand a prospect's business needs.
- Commercial awareness and a desire to learn about recruitment finance, invoice finance and working capital solutions.
- A target-driven mindset without being overly transactional in your approach.

Experience within recruitment finance, invoice finance, commercial finance or working with recruitment agencies would be highly advantageous, but is not essential.

The Opportunity

This is a great opportunity for an ambitious salesperson looking to join a growing business and develop within B2 B financial services.

You will receive exposure to recruitment businesses, finance and working capital solutions, while working alongside an experienced commercial team.

For the right person, there is a clear opportunity to progress from SDR into a Business Development / Account Management position as your experience and understanding of the market develops.

If you're competitive, personable, commercially curious and enjoy opening doors and building relationships, this could be an excellent next step.

If interested, please call me on (phone number removed)

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
We are seeking a proactive and relationship-driven Customer Success Manager to join our client's team. You will be responsible for nurturing strong, long-term relationships with clients and strategic partners, ensuring high levels of satisfaction, engagement, and retention.

As the CSM, you will act as a trusted advisor, guiding customers, managing complex enquiries, and identifying opportunities to expand account value through up sell and cross-sell initiatives.

If you possess a customer-first mindset, excellent communication skills, and a track record of effectively managing multi-account portfolios, we would love to hear from you.

Key responsibilities:
- Serve as the primary point of contact for customer enquiries, escalations, and ongoing support.
- Build and maintain trusted, long-term relationships with customers and key partners. Understanding client goals to ensure services deliver maximum value and satisfaction.
- Guide new customers seamlessly through the on boarding journey. Delivering customer training, live demos, and feature walkthroughs tailored to user needs.
- Conduct regular check-ins and business reviews to capture client feedback and drive continuous satisfaction.
- Establish and nurture collaborative relationships with external service providers, vendors, and strategic partners
- Coordinate with third-party partners and internal operations teams to resolve complex account issues efficiently.
- Partner with the Sales team to support renewal strategies.
- Identify up sell, cross-sell, and account expansion opportunities, as well as lead win-back strategies for legacy accounts.

What we are looking for:
- Proven experience in a similar Customer Service/Success position.
- Passion for delivering exceptional client experiences and solving complex problems.
- Outstanding verbal and written communication skills.
- Demonstrated ability to manage multiple accounts and prioritise tasks in a fast-paced environment.

Details:
- Title: Customer Success Manager
- Salary: 26,000 - 32,000 DOE
- Location: Newbury, fully office-based
